name: precedent
description: Checks an AI coding agent's "I can't" and "done" claims against evidence before they reach you.
long_description: precedent finds proof that a task was done before (agent history, shell history, git), reviews a draft final answer for unproven "can't" and unverified "done", counts repeated failures, and flags test-weakening edits and destructive commands. Standard library only, local, no network, no telemetry.
